column1: # SquachWatch-CYD classic 4MB flash: dual OTA plus safe BlackBox Events (R5)
# R4 filled the original raw BlackBox gap with its expanded OTA app1.
# R5 reduces app1 to 0x1E4000 to reserve 48KB raw
# 0x3E4000..0x3F0000 for Events. app0 and coredump remain unchanged.
# CI verifies actual firmware.bin fits BOTH slots with >=8192B free.
# This layout requires USB browser installation of matching partitions.bin
# at offset 0x8000 and OTA metadata with firmware. OTA firmware-only updates
# cannot change the partition map. Do NOT erase full flash or NVS settings.
# Previous events in old R4-overwritten raw flash cannot be recovered.
